zones.what: Lifeboats are mounted at Deck 8; they obstruct downward and outward views from balconies on Decks 9, 10, and 11, with Deck 9 experiencing the most significant obstruction.
zones.effect: Balcony views look directly at or over lifeboat tops instead of straight down to the water; horizon views remain unobstructed.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests who want unobstructed water views directly below their balcony or enjoy watching port operations; does not matter to those focused on horizon views or who rarely use the balcony.

zones.what: Infinity Beach pool, Infinity Beach bar, and outdoor deck activity areas are directly above on Deck 16.
zones.effect: Daytime noise from pool deck activities, music, and foot traffic overhead; potential for water splashing or drainage sounds; activity extends into evening.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers, those working from the cabin during the day, or anyone sensitive to overhead noise and activity; less relevant to guests who are out exploring most of the day.

zones.what: The Concourse sports complex (including Galaxy Pavilion and stadium seating) is on Deck 17, two decks above Deck 15 and three decks above Deck 14.
zones.effect: Occasional noise from active sports activities above, though distance (multiple decks) provides significant buffering; impact is intermittent rather than constant.
zones.mattersTo: Minor concern for very noise-sensitive guests; most guests will not notice given the vertical distance.

zones.what: The Prima Theater spans Decks 6-8 directly below, with main seating on Deck 7 and balcony seating on Deck 8.
zones.effect: Evening show noise (music, sound effects, applause) transmitted upward during performance times, typically ending by 11 PM; no impact during sea days when theater is dark.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to early-to-bed guests or those in cabin during evening show times; not relevant to night owls or those attending the shows.

zones.what: Indulge Food Hall (buffet venue) is located on Deck 8 aft, two decks below Deck 10 and three decks below Deck 11.
zones.effect: Breakfast and lunch preparation sounds, dishwashing, and high foot traffic during meal hours; vertical distance provides buffering but some sound may transmit during peak meal service.
zones.mattersTo: Potential minor concern for light sleepers during early morning breakfast prep (6-7 AM); distance minimizes impact for most guests.

zones.what: Local Bar and The Commodore are located on Deck 6 directly above.
zones.effect: Evening and late-night bar noise, music, conversation, and foot traffic overhead until closing time (typically midnight or later).
zones.mattersTo: Significant concern for early sleepers or light sleepers; not relevant to late-night guests or those using the cabin primarily for sleeping after midnight.

zones.what: Primary elevator banks are located forward and mid-ship on all cabin decks, with the largest concentration mid-ship.
zones.effect: Cabins immediately adjacent to elevator lobbies experience frequent foot traffic, door chimes, and conversation noise at all hours; cabins further down the corridor are quieter but less convenient.
zones.mattersTo: Convenience vs. noise trade-off: matters to mobility-limited guests who prioritize proximity, and to noise-sensitive guests who should avoid immediately adjacent cabins.

zones.what: Deck 5 aft is low in the ship and closest to propulsion machinery.
zones.effect: Low-frequency vibration and hum, particularly noticeable when the ship is maneuvering or at high speed; most noticeable in the cabin at night.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to vibration-sensitive sleepers or those who notice mechanical hum; many guests acclimate quickly or don't notice.

zones.what: Low forward location exposes cabins to bow thruster use during docking and maneuvering.
zones.effect: Loud thruster noise during port arrivals and departures, typically early morning and evening; brief (15-30 minutes) but can be quite loud.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers during port-intensive itineraries; not a concern on sea days or for those already awake during maneuvering.

zones.what: Forward cabins on lower decks are positioned near the anchor chain mechanism.
zones.effect: Loud metallic chain noise during anchor deployment and retrieval, typically early morning in tender ports; brief but very loud when it occurs.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers on itineraries with tender ports; not a factor on all-dock itineraries or for those awake early.
